job_description:
Research Software Engineer

Join a multidisciplinary climate-data group building dependable tools that help researchers collect, review, and use environmental data. You will work closely with scientists while contributing production-quality software.

Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- 3+ years of professional software-engineering experience.
- Experience building tested services or APIs in Java, Python, or a comparable language.
- Ability to work with researchers to turn data needs into maintainable software.
- Professional Python experience for data-processing workflows.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience operating applications on AWS.
- Experience with scientific Python libraries such as pandas or NumPy.
- Experience maintaining an open-source project.
